atAGlance: Bò xào rau cải is beef quickly stir-fried with leafy greens, usually with garlic, oyster-style sauce, rice, and crisp-tender vegetables.
whatItIs: Bò xào rau cải is beef stir-fried with mustard greens or leafy vegetables, garlic, and savory wok seasoning. It is a family-table plate made for rice.
howToEnjoy: Eat with rice so the garlicky greens and beef juices season the grains. The greens should stay bright, not overcooked.
howLocalsOrder: Order bò xào rau cải as a shared plate. Ask for extra vegetables, less oil, or no chili before the wok starts.
worthKnowing: On Vietnamese rice tables, rau cải can mean mustard greens or similar leafy greens, so expect a slightly bitter, fresh counterpoint to beef.
goodToKnow: Ask for không cay if you want Bò xào rau cải without added chili.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò xào rau cải.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of beef stir-fried with greens.
